## Workload

Grader Tomas Brennan completed the assigned grading activity across 725 sets during 370 rostered hours. This represents an average throughput of 2.0 per hour. The workload record provides a clear basis for assessing the amount of work undertaken and the time available for completion. The review found that the current session pattern supported the recorded level of activity.

## Quality

A further 67 sets were read again as part of the quality check. The recorded agreement between the grader and reviewer was 56.7 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the workload information when reviewing grading consistency and identifying any support or follow-up required. The review was completed by Priya Anand, with Tomas Brennan identified as the grader.
